name: VDS deposit mints 5 VDS per AVD while transfers to the contract redeem AVD 1:1
summary: The unverified VDS token's deposit(referrer, amount) takes AVD and mints 5 VDS per AVD, while a VDS transfer to the VDS contract itself burns the VDS and pays the configured airToken, AVD since setAirToken, 1:1 from the contract's reserve. With 20,000 flash-loaned USDT the attacker bought 69,282 AVD, deposited it for 346,411 VDS, and sent 168,205 VDS back to the contract for 168,205 AVD, then repeated with a smaller deposit, draining 118,018 AVD.
notes: Reset is the owner's setAirToken(AVD) (slot 0xf, read by the redeeming transfer), after setToken(AVD, AVD) made AVD the deposit token (slot 0xc); before it the redemption paid nothing, so the exploit needed it (rule 8). A later tier change (slot 0x3d, 0xfded75fc) only moved a deposit threshold.

Campaign: campaign.mjs over deposit, min3Amount and transfer calls from the reset to the current block; 497 earlier deposits and transfers were ordinary (no transfer to the contract itself before the anchor), and the only other drain is the attacker's second transaction.

AVD has no price; the 118,018 AVD the VDS contract lost net of the attacker's deposits is valued at what the attacker realised, the AVD/USDT pair's 13,658.98 USDT outflow over both transactions (rule 12).
